## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a Conventional Commit (`type(scope): description`, `!` for a breaking change)
- [ ] Tests cover the change and pass locally
- [ ] Lint and format pass (`go vet ./...`, `npm run lint:js`, `npm run lint:md`)
- [ ] No secret, token or credential in the diff
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when behaviour changes
